entities.name: Zegana
entities.description: A merfolk woman who, as Prime Speaker, delivers the Fathom Edict declaring a new Simic Combine.

entities.name: Fathom Edict
entities.description: The speech Zegana gave at the Forum of Azor announcing the merfolk's reemergence and a remade Simic Combine.

entities.name: Forum of Azor
entities.description: The ancient Ravnican venue where Zegana addressed about 12,000 people.

entities.name: Commander Yaszen
entities.description: Commander at Horizon Academy who receives the intelligence transcript.

entities.name: Bogumil Bem
entities.description: Wojek scribe-sergeant who documented the speech.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of biomancers whose remnants the merfolk intend to commandeer and reshape.

entities.name: Merfolk
entities.description: Ravnica's ocean-dwelling people, long hidden under the city, now emerging through zonots.

entities.name: Zonot One
entities.description: The first opened portal between the buried oceans and the surface, reinforced by sea-plants.

entities.name: Zonots
entities.description: Tunnels between Ravnica's surface and its buried oceans, each becoming a community.

entities.name: The Wilds Initiative
entities.description: A cross-guild effort of Golgari, Gruul and Selesnya shamans and druids to cultivate wild space across Ravnica.

entities.name: Momir Vig
entities.description: Former Simic leader whose hubris and creations the merfolk condemn.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: Guild whose magewrights built Ravnica's water systems.

entities.name: Holdfast
entities.description: The merfolk principle binding them to the sea, keeping them rooted and safe.

entities.name: Upwelling
entities.description: The merfolk principle that deep waters must replenish the surface.

entities.name: Horizon Academy
entities.description: Institution of Commander Yaszen, recipient of the report.

events.summary: Zegana enters the Forum of Azor with an entourage and addresses about 12,000 people.
events.quote: took center rostrum, delivered speech to audience of approx 12,000.

events.summary: Zegana explains that merfolk detected tree roots reaching down to their waters, signaling a homecoming.
events.quote: Roots! The taproots of great surface-trees, plumbing the depths through stone and steel to find water.

events.summary: The merfolk deepsages open the first zonot with biomancy, creating their first portal to the surface.
events.quote: With our most powerful biomancy, we opened the first zonot and reinforced it with great lattices of sea-plants.

events.summary: Zegana announces more zonots will be made, each with a speaker, and that she is Prime Speaker.
events.quote: Each zonot will become a community, and each will have a speaker.

events.summary: Zegana reveals the Wilds Initiative cultivated the new growth.
events.quote: the new growth reaching our depths was purposeful, nurtured by The Wilds Initiative.

events.summary: Zegana condemns Momir Vig's hubris and says the merfolk have sought out what remains of the Combine.
events.quote: We have sought out what is left of the Combine.

events.summary: Zegana declares the merfolk to be the Simic, ending the Fathom Edict.
The documenter recommends monitoring zonots and Simic reorganization, pending orders from Commander Yaszen about preventive action.
events.quote: Monitor new Simic Combine activity and organization.

relations.note: Prime Speaker of the zonot speakers.
relations.quote: These speakers will in turn have a prime speaker, and for now I fulfill that role.

relations.note: They condemn his hubris and the havoc of his creations.
relations.quote: the havoc wreaked by his creations is not forgivable.

relations.note: They admire and wish to support its work.
relations.quote: our admiration and our desire to support this work.
Document recipient, primary: Commander Yaszen, Horizon Academy
